name: ICT SMC Smart Scalp Reader

# Put this file at .github/workflows/ict_smc_market_reader.yml
# Put ict_smc_market_reader_v7.py in the repository root.
# Required repository secrets: TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "7,37 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      test_telegram:
        description: "Send a Telegram test message only"
        type: boolean
        default: false
      send_status_updates:
        description: "Send periodic NO TRADE / bot alive messages"
        type: boolean
        default: true
      send_report:
        description: "Send the trade report only"
        type: boolean
        default: false

# One long-running scan at a time. Queued runs must not overlap.
concurrency:
  group: ict-smc-scalp
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  scan:
    name: Smart scalp scan loop
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 62
    env:
      MODE: SCALP
      SCALP_LOOP_MINUTES: "55"
      STATE_FILE: ict_smc_state.json
      SCALP_MIN_SCORE: "7"
      SCALP_COOLDOWN_MIN: "15"
      SCALP_MAX_SIGNALS_PER_DAY: "8"
      ADAPT_ON: "1"
      LEARN_ON: "1"
      LEARN_WINDOW_DAYS: "120"
      LEARN_MIN_TRADES: "20"
      LEARN_BAD_AVG_R: "0.20"
      LEARN_BAD_WINRATE: "0.45"
      MAX_OPEN_PER_SYMBOL: "1"
      MAX_OPEN_TOTAL: "2"
      DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT_R: "3.0"
      TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY }}
      TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN }}
      TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID }}
      SEND_STATUS_UPDATES: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (inputs.send_status_updates && '1' || '0') || '1' }}
      TEST_TELEGRAM: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.test_telegram && '1' || '0' }}
      SEND_REPORT_NOW: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.send_report && '1' || '0' }}

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      # The learning history MUST survive between runs.
      - name: Restore previous learning and trade state
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: ict_smc_state.json
          key: ict-smc-state-${{ github.run_id }}
          restore-keys: |
            ict-smc-state-

      - name: Validate Python syntax
        run: python -m py_compile ict_smc_market_reader_v7.py

      - name: Run ICT SMC Smart Scalp Reader
        run: python ict_smc_market_reader_v7.py

      # Commit the JSON database so learning survives cache eviction and future runs.
      - name: Persist learning database in repository
        if: always() && hashFiles('ict_smc_state.json') != ''
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add ict_smc_state.json
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore: update ICT SMC bot learning state"
            git push
          else
            echo "No state changes to commit."
          fi

      - name: Save cache backup of learning state
        if: always()
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: ict_smc_state.json
          key: ict-smc-state-${{ github.run_id }}
